scientific_integrity: The general proof is deductive and the finite checker is corroborative only. The proof distinguishes existing sharp numerical bounds from the new proposed equality classification and enumeration.
scientific_limitations: Equality classification and the extremal family census are proved only for odd parameter cardinalities in finite simple outerplanar graphs, with external open adjacency types. The sharp numerical inequality was established earlier in locating-domination literature and is not claimed as new. The original 1984 Rall–Slater full text was unavailable; historical priority remains provisional. No independent validation was performed.
title: Hexagonal-block rigidity and the exact extremal census of external one-types in outerplanar graphs
